Hello Cat, nice to meet you! I would like to commission a couple of outfits for my Xaela, if that is OK with you ^_^

I would like casual streetwear-themed outfits:
- one outfit for summer
- one outfit for winter

Here are some outfits I'm inspired by, that feature a boxy silhouette and relaxed fit:
https://wear.jp/suzuchan1206/24471115/
https://wear.jp/suzuchan1206/22885803/
https://wear.jp/suzuchan1206/22641231/

I am happy for her to wear a hat as well, if it fits the outfit. 

I don't have a preference for a colour scheme either.

Thank you for considering my request!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1iO3z6XPInTqWMlNofAzTsjXao_ZwDE42?usp=sharing

Hello! I really liked the OL series you did a little while back, so I'd like to request a dual drawing of my WoL in one of her in-game outfits and one of your OL designs.

My character's demeanor is confident and elegant, but for the OL side you can go with a more reserved look if you want.  OL design specifics and pose are completely up to you.  For the in-game outfit, the sword is optional and can just remain sheathed if you include it.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Xwr5hN_1wyl8pPoO1NWPy5tYStrsy850

Hi! Your drawings are so cute, I'd love to get one of my Au Ra~
Her eyes are silver, she is reserved yet confident ♥
You can choose to simplify the scale/horn designs, I know they are rather complex to draw.

I hope you will accept my request, thank you so much!~

https://imgur.com/a/xysRC08

Hello, and thank you for the appeal! Sorry for the delay, but I'd love for you to draw my Au Ra in her samurai glam. Thank you once more for considering me!

https://imgur.com/a/samurai-reference-dPAgVPU

Hello, I would like a drawing with the pose included in the twitter link. I would like the character to be smiling, with a little heart floating next to her head. Thank you for considering my request.

https://x.com/gummy_sharky/status/1788741691773800506

Hello! I like your art and hope that you accept my request!

I would like you to draw my FFXIV character. She has a cool but cute personality.

Pose, expression, background and any adjustments or changes are up to you. If it’s too much, you do not need to draw the weapon.

Thank you for your consideration!
